summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for new Consultor IA and Alertas modules, plus key regression flows. Backend passed 6/7 targeted tests; one deterministic behavioral failure remains in no-data-month advisor response. Frontend critical routes and interactions validated on desktop and mobile with no horizontal overflow detected.

critical.issue: For month 2025-01 (record_count=0), advisor still expands into July/2026 performance conclusions instead of staying strictly no-data/honest for requested month.

action_items: Enforce backend response guardrail when snapshot.totals.count == 0: advisor must not provide financial-health conclusions from other months unless explicitly requested as comparative context.
Optionally add post-generation validator in /api/advisor/chat to reject/trim responses that violate no-data-month policy before persisting/streaming.
critical_code_review_comments: Prompt-level instruction alone is insufficient for safety-critical financial assertions; add deterministic server-side policy checks for no-data periods.
Consider policy tests for forbidden inference cases (no-data month, bank-balance claims, month mismatch context bleed).
test_credentials: No auth flow in scope; /app/memory/test_credentials.md has no concrete credentials.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ transactions and temporary advisor conversations/receipt during tests; all cleaned up (deleted) after execution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_advisor_alerts_api.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported from frontend/.env. Current expected failing case is no-data month advisor behavior. Frontend desktop/mobile coverage already includes consultor, alertas filters/rules/ack toggle, transactions CRUD, DRE interactions/export click, receipts upload/delete, planilhas, diagnosticos, whatsapp, sidebar and overflow checks.
rca of the issue: RCA: The advisor prompt includes a no-data honesty rule, but runtime output still appends historical month analysis (e.g., July/2026) after stating no records for requested month. There is no deterministic backend post-check to enforce no-data-period output constraints before SSE streaming/persistence. Reproduction: POST /api/advisor/chat with month=2025-01 and generic health question; stream contains meta record_count=0 then narrative using July data. Mitigation: enforce content policy server-side when record_count=0, allowing only no-data guidance and period-request prompts unless user explicitly asks comparative history.
